prior_exposure: Quality/overlap audit and class counts only; no official-test performance scoring or model selection.
comparator: frozen_candidate_v1/binary_standard, same partition and seeds; equal mean probability
classification: positive iff ensemble p >= frozen threshold
primary_estimate: Paired candidate-minus-comparator AUROC on all eligible official test molecules.
reliability_plot: 10 fixed equal-width probability bins [0,.1,...,1], report n, mean p and observed positive fraction; no fitted calibration.

uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional on frozen checkpoints and observed class counts; not training uncertainty; within-scaffold dependence remains.

secondary_scaffold_analysis.definition: Official test molecules whose canonical Murcko scaffold is absent from ALL 20000 development molecules; same empty scaffold convention.
secondary_scaffold_analysis.guard: Report n and class counts first; AUROC only if >=100 positives and >=100 negatives; no model fitting or threshold changes.
secondary_scaffold_analysis.inference: Descriptive subset, not independent external scaffold benchmark.

structure_subgroups.cutpoints: Training-only q75 from frozen 16196 training molecules; high means > q75.

cost_sensitivity.meaning: Illustrative relative costs, not measured financial or clinical cost; no post-test policy selection.

failure_policy: Stop before scoring for hash/count/schema/invalid-SMILES/conflicting-label/overlap mismatch; do not silently drop or correct rows. Record incident and assess whether any test outputs were seen.
exposure_policy: Write an immutable run-start marker before loading test labels; preserve outputs on failure. No rerun to improve scores. Any necessary code-bug rerun must disclose the first exposure and reason.
success_interpretation: AUROC difference with lower 95% bound >0 supports better ranking for this frozen comparison; otherwise evidence is insufficient. Report recall/FPR tradeoff independently. Test recall <.90 must be reported without lowering threshold.
execution_status: NOT RUN; user requested a plan, not test scoring.
